name: Laseria
source: She is Custom's level goddess. Like certain other level goddesses such as Willis, Laseria is known to strip as Custom gains levels to incentivize his progress. In addition to filling the usual level god duties of levelling up her client, she has occasionally rescued Custom from near-death, teleporting him out of dungeons and to safety at the last minute.
